notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.8 - Slave: values that masters write are kept when you press Stop and when you save, including writes to a Slave ID that is not on screen (for example a broadcast); before, they could fall back to the old values. A master that stops halfway through a request is disconnected after 5 s, masters that vanish (power loss, cable pulled) are noticed within about a minute, and when all 16 connections are taken a new master replaces the one that has been quiet longest instead of being refused. Poll and Slave: closing a Slave ID tab now asks before deleting the ID and its points.
